episode_title: Episode 308: How Did a Local Entrepreneur Go From Dog Costumes to Competing with the Biggest Names in Pet Food?

real_qa.q: What is Salty Cat and how does it compete with premium cat food brands while maintaining a value price point?
real_qa.r: Salty Cat's thesis is to take a premium recipe, boil down everything and make it very simple to price it at value level. The company avoids high protein (which overworks a cat's liver), avoids added dyes (which overwork cats' kidneys), identifies all proteins transparently, and includes fish oils for coat health. The brand works with board-certified food scientists who have previously worked with Purina and Friskies to formulate recipes using quality U.S.-sourced vitamin packets and tuna additives for palatability.
real_qa.requete: Salty Cat cat food value pricing premium recipe

real_qa.q: How did Salty Cat secure distribution with major U.S. retailers like Dollar Tree and Walmart?
real_qa.r: Dollar Tree was the door opener after Allison noticed empty cat food shelves during the pandemic when large CPG companies pulled out to focus on higher-margin retailers. She entered Dollar Tree by finding that vacuum in the value market. With Walmart, the company's strong Nielsen sales numbers from Dollar Tree sparked conversations, leading to a test of 500 doors in 2024, then expansion to 1,200 doors. For 2025, Walmart is giving Salty Cat one of the largest resets in its history for an emerging brand, tripling distribution to approximately 3,600 doors because demand exceeded supply expansion by over 600 percentage points.
real_qa.requete: Salty Cat Walmart Dollar Tree distribution deal

real_qa.q: What enterprise resource planning system did Salty Cat implement to scale from $10 million revenue and beyond?
real_qa.r: Allison implemented a heavy-duty ERP (enterprise resource planner) in November 2024 to support growth to nine figures in revenue within four years. The ERP system handles accounting, cost of goods sold, all freight expenses and receipts, inventory tracking with RFID capability, product knowledge storage including packaging and unit size, purchase ordering, EDI data integration, and generates purchase orders and invoices automatically. This system also connects to AI and MCPs to pull data without manual processing, eventually becoming the company's centralized 'source of truth' and operating backbone.
real_qa.requete: ERP system NetSuite Pet Crew Salty Cat scaling

real_qa.q: What is Salty Cat's ranking among cat food companies in America by 2025?
real_qa.r: According to Nielsen reports, Salty Cat is selling 50% of the volume of Royal Canin Cat, one of the massive CPG leaders. At the end of 2024, the company ranked number 72 among the largest cat food companies in America, and by the end of 2025, it expects to be in the top 20 position.
real_qa.requete: Salty Cat ranking cat food company America Nielsen

real_qa.q: How many employees does Salty Cat operate with to generate nearly nine-figure revenue, and what is their revenue-per-employee metric?
real_qa.r: Salty Cat has 15 full-time employees and is expanding to a few more, with manufacturing operations in America, Thailand, and opening Ecuador in spring 2025. The company achieves approximately three million dollars in revenue per person hired, compared to the industry reference point for older CPG companies at around half a million dollars per person. By the end of 2025, the company will approach nine-figure monthly ARR with this lean team structure.
real_qa.requete: Salty Cat team size 15 employees revenue per person
